subject: Adding linear constraints to a model

messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Adding linear constraints to a model
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to add a linear constraint to a model so that the sum of several random effects is equal to zero. Although this feature is mentioned in several papers, I have not been able to find any example about this. Is this a general feature on R-INLA that can be used in the call to inla() or linear constraints need to be implemented within the latent effects?

Best wishes,

Virgilio

its easy to do for each f(), term, using constr=TRUE which sets 1^Tx=0,
or extraconstr = list(A=A,e=e) which sets Ax=e.

if you have f(i) + f(j) and you want A*cbind(x.i,x.j) = e, then this is
different....

let me know...
